_doc: API-URL-GATE-1108b (orchestrator ruling under the owner's deny-by-default API rule, feedback_deny_all_allowlist / feedback_api_robots_policy): a URL that LOOKS like an API call but has no config/api_permissions.json entry is refused by the generic fetchers (vera.api_permissions.gate_url, why unlisted_api_like:<pattern id>). A URL that matches an entry is decided by that entry, never by these patterns. An IP-literal host is refused unless listed in ip_literal_allow (why ip_literal). An unreadable or invalid file refuses every generic fetch (fail closed). Patterns are data: lower-case, matched against the IDNA-mapped host, the normalised path (vera.api_permissions.normalise_path: decoded, dot-segments resolved, lower-case, trailing /) and the lower-cased raw query.
_calibration_note: Measured 2026-11-08 (offline, no network, no DB) on every URL and host name in repo config/*.json (190 URLs, 171 host names) and every URL literal in vera/*.py (38): scratch/API-URL-GATE-1108/cal/survey.py. Spread: the api./eutils. host prefixes matched only API hosts (api.openalex.org, api.crossref.org, api.gdeltproject.org, api.semanticscholar.org, api.unpaywall.org, eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, and the LLM endpoints api.groq.com / api.openai.com reached through their SDK clients, not these fetchers) plus api.slack.com, an official-lane host with no allowed path that 302s to docs.slack.dev. A bare '/api/' segment anywhere would also have matched four documentation PAGES (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, info.arxiv.org/help/api/tou.html, unpaywall.org/products/api, www.semanticscholar.org/product/api), so the path rule is narrowed to a first segment 'api' that is the whole path or is followed by a version segment, or an 'api/v<N>' pair anywhere: it matches the API URLs (export.arxiv.org/api/query is listed; openrouter.ai/api/v1, hn.algolia.com/api/v1, doaj.org/api/v4) and none of those pages. No query marker matched a config or code URL. 1108C (owner H2, review finding 2): api_versioned also takes tagged versions (api/v1beta1), api_rest_versioned (api/rest_v1) and mediawiki_rest (rest.php) are added, mediawiki_api matches api.php with PATH_INFO, and the json query markers match as prefixes (format=jsonp, wt=json.nl). Re-checked by the calibration-corpus test and the 1108C tests; Wikipedia /wiki/ pages stay pages (the api.php and rest.php patterns skip paths under /wiki/, so an article titled Api.php is not refused). Page shapes the app fetches today (arXiv abs/pdf/html, doi.org, Europe PMC and PMC article pages, PubMed, en.wikipedia.org/wiki, publisher landing pages, official-lane and news-outlet hosts) are pinned unrefused by tests/test_api_url_gate_1108b.py. Change this file when a refused page shows up in the R-API-DENIED unlisted_api_like warnings, or when a new API is found reachable as a page.
